questions.stem: The difference between downstream speed and upstream speed of boat is 6 km/hr and boat travels 72 km from P to Q (downstream) in 4 hours. Then find the speed of boat in still water?
questions.explanation: Let the speed of boat in still water be x km/hr and that of stream be y km/hr ATQ, (x + y) – (x – y) = 6 ⇒ 2y = 6 ⇒ y = 3 km/hr Downstream stream = (x + y) = 4 = 18 km/hr ⇒ x = 15 km/hr

questions.stem: A person has purchased two adjacent plots, one is in rectangular shape and other is in square shape and combined them to make a single new plot. The breadth of the rectangular plot is equal to the side of the square plot and the cost of fencing the new plot is Rs. 390 (Rs. 5/m). Find the side of square if the length of the rectangular plot is 15 m.
questions.explanation: Let the breadth of rectangular plot be y m and length = 15 m ATQ, 30 + y + 3y = 390/5 ⇒ 30 + 4y = 78 ⇒ 4y = 48 ⇒ y = 12 m

questions.stem: A shopkeeper marked his article 50% above the cost price and gives a discount of 20% on it. If he had marked his article 75% above the cost price and gives a discount of 20% on it then find the earlier profit is what percent of the profit earned latter?
questions.explanation: Let the CP be Rs. 100x Then, MP = Rs. 150x SP = 150x × 100 = Rs. 120x Profits = Rs. 20x New MP = Rs. 175x New SP = 175x × 100 = Rs. 140x New Profit = Rs. 40x Required % = 20x 40x × 100 = 50%

questions.stem: A person invested two equal amounts in two different schemes. In first scheme, amount is invested at 8% p.a. on SI for T years and SI received is Rs 2000 while in second scheme, amount is invested at 10% p.a. for 2 years at CI and the compound interest received is Rs. 1050. Find the value of T.
questions.explanation: Let the amount be Rs. x CI at 10% in 2 years = 10 + 10 + 10 × 10 100 = 21%. ATQ, x × 21 100 = 1050 ⇒ x = Rs. 5000 And, 5000 × 8 × T = 2000 ⇒ T = 5 years.

questions.stem: Satish saves 20\% of his monthly salary. And of the remaining salary \frac{1}{4} th and \frac{1}{2} th he gives to his mother and sister respectively and the remaining salary he submits as his EMI for the payment of his car. If his annual EMI was Rs. 60,000, then find his monthly salary?
questions.explanation: Let the monthly salary be Rs. 100 x. EMI per month = 100x – (20x + 80x × 4 + 80x × 2) = Rs. 20x ATQ, 20x × 12 = 60,000 ⇒ x = 250 Monthly Salary = Rs. 25,000

questions.stem: The ratio of the diameter of base and height of a cylinder is 2 : 3. Find the radius of the cylinder if the approximate volume of cylinder is 3234.01 cm³?
questions.explanation: Let diameter of base be 2x cm & height of cylinder be 3x cm ∴ radius = 2x 2 = x cm We know, Volume of cylinder = πr2h (r→ radius, h → height) ATQ, πr2h = 3234 7 × x2 × 3x = 3234 x = 7cm Radius = 7cm

questions.stem: Efficiency of B is two times more than efficiency of A. Both started working alternatively, starting with B and completed the work in total 37 days. If C alone complete the same work in 50 days then find in how many days A and C together will complete the work?
questions.explanation: Lets efficiency of A is x unit/day and B’s efficiency is 3x unit/day So, B work for 19 days and A work for 18 days ATQ— Total work = 19 × 3x + 18 × x = 75x Efficiency of C = 75x = 1.5x unit/day (A + C) together = 75x (x+1.5x) = 30 days

questions.stem: 7 men and 6 women together can complete a piece of work in 8 days and work done by a women in one day is half the work done by a man in one day. If 8 men and 4 women started working and after 3 days 4 men left the work and 4 new women joined then, in how many more days will the work be completed
questions.explanation: One day work of women = half of work done by men in one day Let efficiency of one women = w unit/day Man’s efficiency = 2w unit/day Total work = (7 × 2w + 6 × w) × 8 =160w unit 8 men and 4 women start work for 3 days Total work done = (8 × 2w + 4 × w) × 3 = 60w 4 women replace 4 man = (4 × 2w + 8 × w) =16w Days required = 100w 16w = 6.25 days
